defects.summary: Backend instance unreachable from remote browser clients
defects.root_cause: render.yaml was bound to deleted Render free database 'otravelz-db' causing build failures; no active public HTTPS endpoint for Aiven PostgreSQL backend.
defects.remediation: Decoupled render.yaml from dead DB (set DATABASE_URL sync: false, Python 3.12.5), added structured /health with git_sha/database state, and deployed public live HTTPS gateway connected to Aiven Cloud DB.
defects.verification_proof: Probed https://9109f508361c7c.lhr.life/health (200 OK, database: connected). Verified in reports/d1_2_origin_contract.json and reports/d1_2_public_golden_journey.json.

defects.summary: Remote frontend URL returns 404 or pre-V4 stale bundle
defects.root_cause: Remote gh-pages branch was pointing to stale pre-V4 build fa73c2f from Sep 2, 2026.
defects.remediation: Enabled GitHub Pages on Algoryxz/O-Travelz, created 404.html SPA fallback, compiled fresh Web V4 dist bundle with build identity metadata, pushed to gh-pages branch (commits b3dddc8 and 80b3e6b).
defects.verification_proof: Probed https://algoryxz.github.io/O-Travelz/ (200 OK, window.__OTRAVELZ_BUILD__.git_sha matches 593d20263bc3b2442fe3f9ef12dffaefde17b74b). 14/14 steps passed in reports/d1_2_public_golden_journey.json.

defects.summary: deploy-pages.yml built frontend without passing VITE_API_URL or build SHA
defects.root_cause: Build step executed 'npm run build' without binding VITE_API_URL or VITE_BUILD_SHA.
defects.remediation: Configured environment variables in deploy-pages.yml and vite.config.ts to inject git SHA and API base URL at build time.

defects.summary: CORS policy blocked requests from https://algoryxz.github.io
defects.root_cause: Default CORS allowed list did not automatically include the GitHub Pages public origin.
defects.remediation: Updated backend/app/main.py to dynamically and unconditionally include https://algoryxz.github.io and localhost origins with credentials=True.
defects.verification_proof: Confirmed access-control-allow-origin: https://algoryxz.github.io header present on live backend responses in reports/d1_2_origin_contract.json.

defects.summary: Direct navigation to sub-routes on static hosts could 404
defects.root_cause: Static GitHub Pages web server requires 404.html redirect shim or hash-based routing.
defects.remediation: Created frontend/public/404.html redirect script and confirmed Web V4 navigation layer uses hash routing (#discover, #map, #plan, #saved).
defects.verification_proof: Verified direct deep links load correctly in headless Chromium without 404 errors.

defects.root_cause: Missing /images proxy entry in preview server config.
defects.remediation: Added /images proxy configuration to vite.config.ts in D1.1.

defects.summary: Mobile drawer lacked verified test hooks and touch targets
defects.root_cause: Mobile drawer items lacked data-testid attributes.
defects.remediation: Added test hooks and verified responsive layout for mobile viewport 390x844.

defects.summary: Backend threw 500 ValidationError when frontend requested limit=250
defects.root_cause: SearchQueryParams in backend/app/services/search/search_models.py enforced le=200 while route query param allowed up to 500.
defects.remediation: Updated SearchQueryParams limit constraint to le=500, aligning Pydantic validation with FastAPI route definition.
defects.verification_proof: Verified GET /places?limit=250 returns HTTP 200 OK with CORS headers.
